title: Ordering Limits, Upgrade Paths and Order Authorizations for Microsoft 365 Plans
content:
The licensing desk's ordering schedule for Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) sets, for each plan, how many licenses a tenant may hold and order, who the plan may be assigned to, where it can be upgraded to mid-term, and which kind of instruction an order needs.

## License limits and assignment

| Plan | Most licenses per tenant, across all its subscriptions of the plan | Fewest licenses on a new subscription or seat addition | Frontline workers only | Provisioning target |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | 300 | 1 | no | 4 hours |
| Microsoft 365 F3 | unlimited | 1 | yes | 4 hours |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | 300 | 1 | no | 4 hours |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | 300 | 1 | no | 4 hours |
| Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams) | unlimited | 1 | no | 4 hours |
| Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) | unlimited | 1 | no | 4 hours |

- **Frontline workers only**: whether the plan may be assigned only to frontline workers who do not use a dedicated computer.
- **Provisioning target**: the target hours from purchase to the licenses being assignable.

## Mid-term upgrade paths

| Plan | Plans it may be upgraded to mid-term | Part of the licenses may be upgraded | Lower plan may take effect before term end |
|---|---|---|---|
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | Microsoft 365 Business Standard, Microsoft 365 Business Premium, Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams), Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) | no | no |
| Microsoft 365 F3 | Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams), Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) | no | no |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | Microsoft 365 Business Premium, Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams), Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) | no | no |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams), Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) | no | no |
| Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams) | Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) | no | no |
| Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) | none | no | no |

## Order authorizations

| Plan | Signed order form of the authorized contact needed for a new subscription, cancellation, renewal change or upgrade | Seat addition may be placed on the instruction of a verified authorized contact without an order form |
|---|---|---|
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | yes | yes |
| Microsoft 365 F3 | yes | yes |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | yes | yes |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | yes | yes |
| Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams) | yes | yes |
| Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) | yes | yes |

## Points of judgement

- A tenant holding 300 Microsoft 365 Business Premium licenses has reached that plan's limit. On Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams) the same tenant has no limit.
- Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) is the top of every upgrade path. It has no mid-term upgrade of its own.
- No plan allows upgrading only part of a subscription's licenses, and no plan lets a move to a lower plan take effect mid-term.
